summary: Derived cash-flow summaries in underwriting-api have no owner and no retention classification. Document ingestion records both. The retention job deletes raw documents only and emits a deletion audit event. Nothing in the packet or the policy config says how long that audit record is kept.

findings.rationale: The cash-flow summary comment says the row has no owner, and the insert does not write one.

evidence.rationale: The file states that the row has no owner.

proposedTasks.title: Record an owner on each cash-flow summary
acceptanceCriteria: A unit test asserts the inserted cash-flow summary includes a non-empty owner.
The owner stored on the row is the team name a reviewer can read without opening another service.

findings.rationale: The insert writes application id, inflow, and captured date. It does not write a retention classification id.

evidence.rationale: The inserted columns do not include a classification id.

proposedTasks.title: Store the policy classification id on the summary
acceptanceCriteria: A unit test asserts the inserted summary stores a retention classification id.
That id is derived-underwriting-summary, which is present in the policy config.
The test does not expect a retention duration on the row.

findings.rationale: The extracted artifact sets owner to the document-platform constant.
The artifact stores the classification id derived-underwriting-summary. The duration for that id is only in the policy config.

evidence.rationale: The classification id constant is declared here.

findings.rationale: Coverage is the raw-bank-document classification. The comment says derived cash-flow summaries are not in the list.

evidence.rationale: The coverage list and the comment exclude derived summaries.

proposedTasks.title: Add derived underwriting summaries to deletion coverage
acceptanceCriteria: A unit test asserts COVERED_CLASSIFICATION_IDS includes derived-underwriting-summary.
Deleting an object with that classification id removes the object.
An object classified only as raw-bank-document is still deleted.

findings.rationale: A covered deletion returns a deletion audit event.

evidence.rationale: deleteCoveredObject returns the result of emitDeletionAudit.

findings.rationale: The file emits a deletion audit event and says it does not record how long that event is kept. The policy config has no retention period for an audit record.

evidence.rationale: The file states that it does not say how long the audit event is kept.

unknowns: The retention period of the deletion audit record is not in the policy config or this file.

unresolvedQuestions: Where is the retention period of a deletion audit record defined?
